info.prompt: Ultrawide cinematic composition blending three key elements: (1) Left-third close-up of a player's trembling hand hovering over BANK button at 4.0× multiplier with 12k unbanked points, their geometric avatar reflected in the sweat-slick touchscreen; (Center) The main board in explosive transition between PRIME and FRENZY modes, energy thresholds crossing as granite obstacles shatter; (Right) A real-time probability calculator overlay in {DOS green|synthwave pink} showing Farkle risk percentages updating with each tile highlight, all wrapped in gothic stained-glass data visualizations.
